name: Family Crisis
description: Your family needs you. But your career is taking off...

chapters.title: The First Call
chapters.description: Your mom called. Something's wrong at home. You can hear the stress in her voice.

choices.label: Go Home
choices.description: Drop everything and go. Family comes first.

choices.label: Send Money
choices.description: Send support but stay focused on the upcoming battle.

choices.label: Focus on Career
choices.description: They'll understand. You have a battle coming up.

chapters.title: Things Getting Worse
chapters.description: The money helped, but they still need you. Your sister called crying.

choices.label: Finally Go Home
choices.description: You've put it off long enough. Time to handle this.

choices.label: Keep Sending Money
choices.description: Maybe more money will fix it. You can't leave now.

chapters.title: The Fallout
chapters.description: Your family stopped calling. You hear through others that things got bad. Real bad.

choices.label: Try to Reconnect
choices.description: Swallow your pride. Pick up the phone.

choices.label: They Made Their Choice
choices.description: You can't force them to forgive you. Focus on what you can control.

chapters.title: Running Dry
chapters.description: You're broke from sending money, and nothing's changed at home. The stress is showing in your battles.

choices.label: Just Go Home
choices.description: Money didn't work. Maybe you being there will.

choices.label: Stop Trying
choices.description: You gave everything you could. It's not enough.

chapters.title: Second Chance
chapters.description: They answered. It's awkward, but they're willing to talk. This might be your last chance.

choices.label: Make Time For Them
choices.description: Cancel everything. Be there. Really be there.

choices.label: Quick Visit
choices.description: Stop by, but you've got obligations. They'll understand.

endings.title: Family First
endings.description: You dropped everything when it mattered. They'll never forget that. Your mom hugged you at the door and didn't let go for five minutes.

endings.title: Better Late Than Never
endings.description: It took a while, but you came through. The damage isn't fully healed, but you're working on it.

endings.title: Stronger Than Before
endings.description: Going through this together made your family bond stronger. They show up to your battles now. Front row.

endings.title: Distant But Civil
endings.description: You're not close anymore, but you're not enemies. Holiday phone calls and birthday texts. It's something.

endings.title: Estranged
endings.description: Your family has moved on without you. Your name doesn't come up at dinner anymore. The success tastes different now.

endings.title: It's Too Late
endings.description: Something happened while you were busy. You weren't there. You'll carry this forever. Every success is hollow now.
